description: This file defines the main application routes/layout for a React-based notes management frontend, utilizing Remix framework functions such as loaders, navigation, and context for state management.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that ensures user authentication and provides user data to the component.

methods.name: AppLayout
methods.description: Main application layout component that sets up headers, notes provider, and routing.

methods.name: MainLayout
methods.description: Component that renders the main content area, including note list, outlet for nested routes, and a floating button for creating new notes.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the action of creating a new note and navigating to its specific page.
